result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major layout problem with overlapping, unreadable text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line is garbled with overlapping text — characters for the delivery time/delivery info collide (appears as '25-3Ord...livery • Ramen'), making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout/constraints of the metadata row so delivery time, delivery fee and cuisine render on a single non-overlapping line, remove any absolutely-positioned or duplicate text layer, and verify text truncation/wrapping at this card width.
